programmes.d: Jasper King has asked his old friend Cisco to help him stop the marriage between his niece Nancy and the gangster Duke Ralston.
Cisco and Pancho try to help a young bank teller, whose marriage to the bank president's daughter is endangered by two gunmen who are blackmailing him about a secret from his past.
With an outlaw at large and the Sheriff searching for him, trouble arrives in the form of a fake sheriff, a drunk, and a senseless murder.

While awaiting word from the mine to see if they found gold, Annie discovers a beloved stagecoach is now being driven by a woman, the daughter of the owner who is now threatening to sell the stage and pocket the money.
The owner of the mine is bushwhacked, but lives long enough to ask Annie to send for his daughter. His killer still unknown, the daughter has a big decision to make on the running of the mine.
When an alms-seeker, who has brought good luck to Jim Bowie, is brutally attacked for no apparent reason, Bowie finds him a haven with the 10-year-old Marquis and his aunt.
Jim Bowie and Osceola, Seminole renegade chief, match knife against lance, with complications for Bowie in trying to get Osceola to compromise with the United States.
Bowie buys a lottery ticket from Jean Dubois, a former champion swordsman, who is trying to raise money for his daughter's dowry.
With the cooperation of the United States Army, Bowie sets out to carry half a million dollars in gold from Baton Rouge to New Orleans, but before he reaches his destination he runs into trouble.
Cisco and Pancho break a woman out of jail after she has been sentenced to hang for a murder she did not commit.
Jasper King has asked his old friend Cisco to help him stop the marriage between his niece Nancy and the gangster Duke Ralston.
Cisco and Pancho try to help a young bank teller, whose marriage to the bank president's daughter is endangered by two gunmen who are blackmailing him about a secret from his past.
Josh arrives in a town for rest and to gamble just as the local bank has been robbed.
A widow wants to hire/propose to Josh so she doesn't lose custody of her son.
A woman asks Josh, an old friend, to help find her husband Frank - a bounty hunter out to settle a score.
When Randall has a sheriff bed a prisoner, the man's gang kidnaps the sheriff and two others and threatens to kill one per day until the man is freed.
In Mexico, Josh is hired to protect a sensible man and his pregnant wife from his father-in-law and the villagers who are angered when he refuses the town healing woman or \\"witch\\".
After Josh reluctantly takes the task of finding a man and his wife's pet ewe, he becomes the butt of many jokes in the community while cattlemen nearly hang him when he mentions sheep.
When a convicted killer escapes prison, Josh is hired for $500 to protect the woman whose testimony put him there.
Josh rides into a town looking for a man who asked him to come there for a job that pays $500.
Josh is hired by Harry Weaver to track down his twin brother Pete, who's wanted with a $500 bounty on him.
Josh is called in to track down a new outlaw - the local sheriff who is a friend.
Josh reluctantly takes a job protecting a beautiful deaf, mute, teenage girl and keeping everyone off the father's place for a day or two.
Josh escorts an East Coast photographer to take a picture of his friend El Gato (The Cat), who is a famous, hilarious bandit living in the hills of Mexico with a small army.
A broke Josh is hired by a fearful man to help him elope with his sweetheart, Jane, the daughter of a local rancher.
Josh takes a job for $200 protecting an express office employee who stole $10,000 and wants to return it before it's discovered missing.
A Japanese woman travels to the U.S. to find an American man who proposed to her in Japan and hires Josh to find him since no one will help her in her search.
Josh arrives in town thinking the sheriff summoned him to go after a man.
Josh rides to Barney Durant's horse business to rent a couple of horses right after Barney pushes his son David to leave.
While pursuing Carl Martin, Josh stops at a marshal's office where Carl is being held.
A reclusive old man with an Apache bodyguard is wanted for a crime committed long ago.
A ranch manager hires Randall to bring back a line rider charged with grand theft.
Randall is rooked into advancing half the bounty to a man who promises to lead him to the wanted criminal Shawnee Bill, but Bill may be closer than Randall thinks.
A feud erupts among two Native tribes: a member of one tribe has stolen a revered portrait from another tribe.
A politician tries to get Columbia picked as California's capital city.
The romance of young lovers is threatened by their feuding families.
A teacher stages a holdup as a joke but decides to make a career of it.
Nevada's road to statehood becomes entwined in a trial concerning mining claims and Civil War allegiances.
Two partner prospectors sell out to the wealthy Spencer Gates and their lives take different paths.
The story of Cherokee tribesman Sequoia, who developed the Cherokee written language.
The tumultuous life of Lola Montez, a dancer who goes through fame and several fortunes.
A tenderfoot becomes a swamper with the Big Team to prove his worth to the girl he loves.
A man must collect back taxes and hires some muscle for assistance, but a surprise awaits him.
A prospector in San Francisco encounters the temptations of the big city cause many problems with his wife.
Two prospectors play a cruel joke: they offer a friend shares in their mine if he'll marry the homely Aggie.
Nina pledges to wait for Terry, who leaves to find fortune, but life moves on when she doesn't hear from him.
